scope: server-available real A2 assets only; no Mac archive or full normal/bad set

developmentRoiAlignment.roiStatus: development diagnostic only; not frozen for production

boundedInterpretation: The overlay visually associates candidate-002 and candidate-003 with the two visible upper gaps, but this is a review observation, not drawing-role truth.
Candidate-001 overlaps the right/lower interference boundary and must be confirmed as a real shell feature or rejected as occlusion.
The three single-ray pair included angles are approximately 100.257, 63.771 and 36.486 degrees; none is within the drawing label 85 +/- 5 degrees.
An opposed-axis combination can appear numerically close to 85 degrees only while its datum opposition error is about 143.514 degrees, so it is geometrically invalid and must not be accepted.
One development image cannot establish ROI stability, candidate repeatability, failure rates, normal accuracy or bad-image false-positive rate.
minimumFieldQuestions: On the numbered overlay, fill exactly: datum_primary candidate ID; datum_secondary candidate ID or NONE; target_left candidate ID; interference candidate IDs.
Confirm whether the datum is one slot ray, an upper/lower opposed-slot axis, or another explicitly marked geometry; if another, mark it on the same frame.
Confirm whether 85 +/- 5 degrees is a drawing OK/NG tolerance or an input to mechanical correction; if correction, provide the formula separately from the measured angle.
Provide at least 20 representative frames spanning expected part positions to confirm or reject the development ROI before freezing it.
Provide capture grouping and independent truth for the full normal set, plus the full bad-image set, before accuracy and false-positive acceptance.
